before.detail: Staged cast requested a scene despite an outstanding control acknowledgment.

after.formatting: rustfmt +1.97.1 --edition 2024 for affected source; git diff --check

scenario: An acknowledged-at-authority command reply is withheld; a later staged cast must wait for its validated control header without an extra scene request, then bind and execute once in sequence.
limitations: This tests the extra refresh wait; it does not establish the cause of all battle movement expiries.
